title: Binance Will List Ethereum Name Service (ENS)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list  Ethereum Name Service (ENS)  and will open trading for  ENS/BTC ,  ENS/BNB ,  ENS/BUSD , and  ENS/USDT  trading pairs at 2021-11-10 07:00 (UTC). Users can now start depositing  ENS  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for ENS will open at 2021-11-11 07:00 (UTC) Note: The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page. What is Ethereum Name Service (ENS)? The Ethereum Name Service is a distributed, open, and extensible naming system based on the Ethereum blockchain. The Ethereum Name Service’s job is to map human-readable names like ‘alice.eth’ to machine-readable identifiers such as Ethereum addresses, other cryptocurrency addresses, content hashes, and metadata. ENS is the native token of the system and is used for governance and voting on the use of treasury grants. ENS Listing Fee: 0 BNB.
